purpose: Select one finite historical-only Campaign058 mechanism after Campaign057 using frozen definitions, source schema, and point-in-time semantics only, before reading any Campaign058 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The percentage-point spread between already-effective profit YoY and revenue YoY states measures operating leverage or margin-direction pressure. None of the 81 current minute/disclosure-timing definitions measures this joint accounting relation, and it is not the average-rank quality-growth or quality-score composite.
Each is an older direct quality comparison definition and would simply rerun an exposed level factor.

Those older composites reward jointly high percentile levels. Campaign058 instead freezes a raw percentage-point contrast whose sign distinguishes profit growth outrunning revenue growth from the reverse.
Ratios become unstable near zero and rank/log alternatives would create a transform search. Raw percentage-point subtraction is the sole scale and transform.
Acceleration reopens two older exposed direct comparison factors and adds a sparse prior-year-quarter dependency. Campaign058 uses the latest already-effective levels only.
No announcement window, value threshold, selected report type, minute-price regime, board, year, filter, fit, model, or terminal-factor combination is searched.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_profit_revenue_growth_spread_pp
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When already-public profit growth exceeds already-public revenue growth, operating leverage or margin expansion may indicate resilient earnings quality that remains relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: At signal close t, after accepted effective-date ordering, same-effective-date deduplication, and independent point-in-time forward fill of revenue_yoy and profit_yoy, return profit_yoy_state_t - revenue_yoy_state_t in percentage points.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Each disclosure becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort by instrument, effective date, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last row per instrument and effective date before state propagation.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill revenue_yoy and profit_yoy independently inside each instrument exactly as the accepted quality-state semantics require; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both already-effective states are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, rescale, rank inside the formula, substitute another field, or select a favorable report.

decision.next_action: Challenge the raw operating-leverage spread against all 81 current definitions and all eight older quality semantic definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first no-return protocol before any Campaign058 source row or value is read.
